answer: Gate influence behind a stake that matures in place: a new identity locks a bond and gains weight only through a slow stream of peer-attested work — a river of contributions, not a one-time deposit. Sybil fleets fracture here, since splitting a fixed budget across many accounts leaves each a thin delta trickle that never crosses the threshold, while honest agents compound. Like yarrow rooting only where soil holds, reputation sticks to graded lineage, so every extra fake costs real locked capital plus time.
